# REMAINING WORK — UI/API Total Sovereignty

The Awtsmoos renews every pixel and packet, every button and boundary in one indivisible now;
Awtsmoos.com receives the work as many small vessels, each scoped so no neighboring page must ever bow.

## Global UI work
- [ ] Inventory route families and stylesheet adoption without scanning archived transfer copies as live pages.
- [ ] Build a route-to-style-authority map: future-system, geelooy-system, geelooy-app, social-system, civilization, auth, OCR, home shells, app-local styles.
- [ ] Detect shared/global selectors that escape their intended root.
- [ ] Detect duplicate ownership of the same component classes across style systems.
- [ ] Detect fixed-position, width/min-width, transform, overflow, and z-index patterns likely to escape narrow viewports.
- [ ] Ensure all shared design systems use local z-layer variables instead of arbitrary global escalation.
- [ ] Ensure interactive elements have hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, busy, invalid, expanded/selected/current states where semantically relevant.
- [ ] Gate hover-only animation behind hover-capable pointers.
- [ ] Provide reduced-motion, reduced-data/update, forced-colors, and high-contrast fallbacks.
- [ ] Ensure touch targets and controls remain usable at 320px-wide mobile viewports.
- [ ] Prefer native details/disclosure and explicit retractable panels for advanced UI.
- [ ] Avoid style resets that target raw body/form/input/button elements without a page-root scope.

## Immediate family: authentication
- [ ] Preserve current `.login-page` / `.register-page` roots and localize every auth selector beneath them.
- [ ] Complete `style/forms.css` imports for all auth modules.
- [ ] Eliminate unscoped `form`, label/input/button selectors.
- [ ] Add complete field/autofill/invalid/disabled/busy states.
- [ ] Add professional mobile-first shell sizing and viewport-safe card behavior.
- [ ] Add restrained futuristic aura/motion with reduced-motion fallback.
- [ ] Refactor duplicated login/register server-template helpers only after CSS family is green.
- [ ] Add/expand auth contract tests proving scoping/import/state/overflow rules.
- [ ] Browser-test login and registration at narrow and desktop widths.

## Shared JS/API work
- [ ] Audit future-system controller contracts and page adoption.
- [ ] Build or extend small base classes where lifecycle, abort, event ownership, network state, and disclosure behavior repeat.
- [ ] Audit page-level fetch/API wrappers for duplicated JSON/error/loading/retry/auth handling.
- [ ] Prefer data descriptors + class coordinators + specialist modules over imperative DOM monoliths.
- [ ] Preserve JSDoc richness; split files rather than shorten documentation to meet 120 lines.
- [ ] Require complete `@description`, `@param`, `@returns`, and error/side-effect documentation for touched functions.

## Page-family migration order
- [ ] Auth/login/register/logout.
- [ ] Root/about/profile/apps/games/wallet.
- [ ] Docs/API docs.
- [ ] Legacy utilities: CSV, OCR, byte viewer, archive uploader, fetch, record/recorder.
- [ ] Editors/composers/social surfaces.
- [ ] OS/file explorer/drive.
- [ ] Remaining app/game families, preserving local ownership and nested AGENTS rules.

## Verification
- [ ] CSS scoping tests.
- [ ] CSS import-cycle and duplicate-owner tests.
- [ ] JS syntax + tabs + <=120 source-file gate.
- [ ] Browser console/network checks.
- [ ] Mobile overflow detection at 320/360/390px.
- [ ] Desktop checks at 1280/1440px.
- [ ] Keyboard-only navigation and focus visibility.
- [ ] Reduced-motion and forced-colors checks.
- [ ] Planned-vs-actual delta and shadow-work review.

## NEXT_ACTION
Finish the live auth stylesheet audit, then rewrite the auth stylesheet family as a strictly root-scoped reference implementation before touching page-family HTML or JS.
